applications.name: HD2 Arsenal
applications.summary: Helldivers 2 mod library, profiles, deployment, pack builder and lobby loadout coordination. Documentation reviewed; installation and implementation not verified.
applications.license: Application license unverified; official release repository says development is private
applications.pricing_notes: Official site describes Arsenal as free. Nexus Premium-gated integrations have separate account requirements.
applications.platform_notes: Official site lists Windows, Linux and SteamOS; no installation tested.
features: Deployment status and option-aware conflict inspection
Separators, tag filters and list minimap
Mod pack builder and lobby loadout sync
limitations: Release-only public repository, not application source
No independent runtime, performance or security verification
Lobby mod sharing documented as Nexus-identity-dependent
Interrupted deploy can leave inconsistent files according to documentation

recommendation.pick_for: Inspecting Helldivers 2-specific management workflows and source-attributed design patterns.
recommendation.compare_when: Verify installation, compatibility and recovery on owned fixtures before daily use; other games need their own adapters.

maintenance.note: Official release list shows 0.37.2; release activity does not establish support quality.
